BLACK_STAR.description: Elites drop an additional Relic. If obtained in Act 3 or later, immediately obtain 1 random Relic.
BLOOD_SOAKED_ROSE.description: Gain 1 Energy. Add 1 Enthralled Curse to your deck.
BRILLIANT_SCARF.description: Every turn, the 6th card you play costs 0.
CHOICES_PARADOX.description: At the start of each combat, choose 1 of 5 usable Rare cards to add to your hand. It gains Retain and is removed after combat.
CHOICES_PARADOX.selectionScreenPrompt: Choose 1 Rare card to add to your hand.
CLAWS.description: Choose 1 of 4 Curses to add to your deck. Add 2 Wish and 1 upgraded Wish+.
CROSSBOW.description: At the start of each turn, you may add a random Attack to your hand. It costs 1 less this turn and gains Ethereal and Exhaust.
DISTINGUISHED_CAPE.description: On pickup, lose 30% of current Max HP, at least 18. Add 3 Apparitions.
DISTINGUISHED_CAPE.eventDescription: Lose 30% of current Max HP, at least 18. Add 3 Apparitions.
DISTINGUISHED_CAPE.unpayableOption: Max HP too low to pay this cost ({Cost}).
ECTOPLASM.description: Gain 1 Energy. On pickup, gain 250 Gold. You can no longer gain Gold.
FIDDLE.description: At the start of each turn, draw until you have 7 cards. During your turn, draw effects cannot make your hand exceed 7 cards.
IRON_CLUB.description: Whenever you play 5 cards, draw 1 card.
JEWELED_MASK.description: On pickup, choose a Power. It permanently costs 0. At the start of each combat, move it from your draw pile to your hand.
JEWELED_MASK.ezSelectionScreenPrompt: Choose a Power to permanently cost 0.
JEWELRY_BOX.description: Add 1 Apotheosis to your deck. It does not have Innate.
MEAT_CLEAVER.description: Adds the Cook option to rest sites. Cook: remove 2 cards and lose 5 HP.
MUSIC_BOX.description: Each turn, the first Attack you play creates a copy in your hand. The copy costs 1 less this turn and has Ethereal and Exhaust.
PAELS_HORN.description: Add 1 Relax and 1 upgraded Relax+ to your deck.
PAELS_TOOTH.description: Remove 5 cards. After every 2 non-boss combats, choose 1 stored removed card to return to your deck upgraded. After the act boss, remaining stored cards are removed permanently.
PRESERVED_FOG.description: Remove 4 cards. Add 1 Folly to your deck.
PRISMATIC_GEM.description: Gain 1 Energy. Every second standard card reward contains only off-color cards.
PRISMATIC_GEM.countHint.title: Prismatic count: {Count}/{Cycle}
PRISMATIC_GEM.countHint.nextNormal: Next standard card reward is normal.
PRISMATIC_GEM.countHint.nextOffColor: Next standard card reward contains only off-color cards.
PRISMATIC_GEM.rewardScreenHint: Prismatic reward: only off-color cards this time.
SEAL_OF_GOLD.description: Gain 1 Energy. Add 2 playable Debt Curses to your deck.
SOZU.description: Gain 1 Energy. On pickup, fill all empty Potion slots. You can no longer obtain Potions.
TOASTY_MITTENS.description: Before drawing each turn, view the top card of your draw pile. You may Exhaust it to gain 1 Strength.
Use [gold]Compost Reward[/gold] on Act [blue]1[/blue] normal combat card rewards for [blue]15[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold]. The [blue]3[/blue]rd compost removes up to [blue]2[/blue] cards and offers [blue]1[/blue] upgraded card.
A sealed token for the pact beneath the roots.
EZMICROBALANCE-UrdaMoltingOptionRelic.de: Remove [blue]1[/blue] Strike and [blue]1[/blue] Defend, then add [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Withered Husk[/gold] cards. Remaining [gold]Withered Husk[/gold] cards are removed at Act [blue]2[/blue] start.
EZMICROBALANCE-UrdaMoltingOptionRelic.fl: A sealed token for the bark left behind.
EZMICROBALANCE-UrdaMossMapOptionRelic.de: The first Act [blue]1[/blue] Monster, Event, Shop, [gold]Elite[/gold], and Rest Site each grant a different reward: [gold]Gold[/gold], healing, [gold]Potion[/gold], upgrade, or [gold]Max HP[/gold].
EZMICROBALANCE-UrdaMossMapOptionRelic.fl: A sealed token for the path hidden by moss.
EZMICROBALANCE-UrdaSeedbedOptionRelic.de: Take [gold]Seedling[/gold] from Act [blue]1[/blue] normal combat card rewards: lose [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Max HP[/gold] and add a [gold]Seedling[/gold]. The first is upgraded. The [blue]4[/blue]th accept grants [blue]10[/blue] [gold]Max HP[/gold] without healing current HP.
EZMICROBALANCE-UrdaSeedbedOptionRelic.fl: A sealed token for a patient seed.
EZMICROBALANCE-URDA_HUMUS_PACT_OPTION_RE: Use [gold]Compost Reward[/gold] on Act [blue]1[/blue] normal combat card rewards for [blue]15[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold]. The [blue]3[/blue]rd compost removes up to [blue]2[/blue] cards and offers [blue]1[/blue] upgraded card.
A sealed token for the pact beneath the roots.
EZMICROBALANCE-URDA_MOLTING_OPTION_RELIC: Remove [blue]1[/blue] Strike and [blue]1[/blue] Defend, then add [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Withered Husk[/gold] cards. Remaining [gold]Withered Husk[/gold] cards are removed at Act [blue]2[/blue] start.
A sealed token for the bark left behind.
EZMICROBALANCE-URDA_MOSS_MAP_OPTION_RELI: The first Act [blue]1[/blue] Monster, Event, Shop, [gold]Elite[/gold], and Rest Site each grant a different reward: [gold]Gold[/gold], healing, [gold]Potion[/gold], upgrade, or [gold]Max HP[/gold].
A sealed token for the path hidden by moss.
EZMICROBALANCE-URDA_SEEDBED_OPTION_RELIC: Take [gold]Seedling[/gold] from Act [blue]1[/blue] normal combat card rewards: lose [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Max HP[/gold] and add a [gold]Seedling[/gold]. The first is upgraded. The [blue]4[/blue]th accept grants [blue]10[/blue] [gold]Max HP[/gold] without healing current HP.
A sealed token for a patient seed.
EZMICROBALANCE-URDA_TRIAL_BRANCH_OPTION_: Choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]4[/blue] cards. It is upgraded, added to your deck, and marked [gold]Trial Plant[/gold]. Play it in at least [blue]2[/blue] of the next [blue]3[/blue] combats to keep it; otherwise it is removed.
A sealed token with a green shoot through the verdict line.
EZMICROBALANCE-URDA_SHALLOW_ROOT_RELIC_O: Choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]2[/blue] common relics and gain [blue]75[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold]. Defeat an Act [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Elite[/gold] to root it permanently and gain [blue]35[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold]. If Act [blue]2[/blue] starts first, Urda takes the shallow relic back and refunds [blue]75[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold].
A sealed token whose roots have not found stone yet.
EZMICROBALANCE-URDA_ROOTED_ROUTE_OPTION_: Urda marks a reachable Act [blue]1[/blue] combat in the first [blue]7[/blue] floors. Reach the [gold]Root Mark[/gold] to receive [blue]3[/blue] single-card rewards; the first is upgraded, and you gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Potion[/gold] if possible. Miss the mark to lose [blue]8[/blue] HP and gain [blue]25[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold].
A sealed token threaded with a route only roots can read.
EZMICROBALANCE-URDA_AFTER_RAIN_OPTION_RE: Act [blue]1[/blue] only. First lethal damage prevents death, sets HP to [blue]1[/blue], grants [blue]15[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold], draws [blue]1[/blue], adds [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Wound[/gold] cards, and loses [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Max HP[/gold]. Until then, Act [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Elite[/gold] kills grant [blue]20[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold], max [blue]2[/blue]. Unused at Act [blue]2[/blue]: heal [blue]8[/blue] and gain [blue]75[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold].
A sealed token still wet from the storm that spared it.
EZMICROBALANCE-URDA_ROOT_SIGHT_OPTION_RE: Gain [blue]5[/blue] [gold]Root Eye[/gold]. Immediately, and as you move, Urda spends [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Root Eye[/gold] to mark a reachable non-Boss room. First mark grants [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Potion[/gold] if possible.
A sealed token with an eye pressed into living bark.
EZMICROBALANCE-URDA_SEED_BANK_OPTION_REL: Use [gold]Store Seed[/gold] on Act [blue]1[/blue] normal combat card rewards to save [blue]1[/blue] offered card, max [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Seed[/gold] cards. Before the Act [blue]1[/blue] Boss, choose up to [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Seed[/gold] cards. The first chosen card is upgraded. Unchosen [gold]Seed[/gold] cards disappear.
A sealed token that rattles with future leaves.
EZMICROBALANCE-LOTHA_CLOSED_COURT_OPTION: For the rest of the run, post-combat card rewards no longer appear; [gold]Gold[/gold], potions, and relics remain. At the start of your first turn each combat, draw until your hand has [blue]10[/blue] cards, gain [blue]4[/blue] [gold]Energy[/gold], and your first [blue]3[/blue] player-played cards this turn cost [blue]1[/blue] less [gold]Energy[/gold] for that play.
A sealed token from a locked courtroom.
EZMICROBALANCE-LOTHA_DEATH_REPRIEVE_OPTI: Once per run, when your HP would drop to [blue]0[/blue] or less, prevent death and set HP to [blue]1[/blue]. Your reprieve begins on your current player turn, or on your next player turn if this triggers outside your turn. During the reprieve, draw [blue]10[/blue] cards, gain [blue]10[/blue] [gold]Energy[/gold], your cards cost [blue]0[/blue], and you cannot die. At the end of that player turn, if any enemies remain, die; otherwise continue the run.
A sealed token for one delayed final sentence.
EZMICROBALANCE-LOTHA_DEFERRED_VERDICT_OP: On turn [blue]4[/blue], draw [blue]4[/blue] cards, gain [blue]4[/blue] [gold]Energy[/gold], and gain [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Verdict[/gold]. This turn, each next non-Status card consumes [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Verdict[/gold]. [gold]Attack[/gold] and [gold]Skill[/gold] cards play [blue]1[/blue] extra time. [gold]Power[/gold] cards cost [blue]0[/blue] and draw [blue]1[/blue]. If combat ends before turn [blue]4[/blue], heal [blue]4[/blue] HP.
A sealed token waiting for the third exhibit.
EZMICROBALANCE-LOTHA_MIRROR_HALL_ECHO_OP: At turn end, remember the last [gold]Attack[/gold], [gold]Skill[/gold], or [gold]Power[/gold] you played. Next turn, your first card of that type triggers and clears the echo. [gold]Attack[/gold] and [gold]Skill[/gold] cards play [blue]1[/blue] extra time. [gold]Power[/gold] cards cost [blue]0[/blue] and draw [blue]1[/blue].
A sealed token reflected from every wall.
EZMICROBALANCE-LOTHA_MIRROR_REBUTTAL_OPT: Choose [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Attack[/gold], [gold]Skill[/gold], or [gold]Power[/gold] from your deck. At combat start, move it to your hand if possible. The first time you play it each combat: [gold]Attack[/gold] or [gold]Skill[/gold] plays [blue]2[/blue] extra times; [gold]Power[/gold] costs [blue]0[/blue], then gives [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Energy[/gold] and draws [blue]2[/blue].
A sealed token that answers the first wound.
EZMICROBALANCE-LOTHA_PRESUMPTION_OPTION_: At combat start, gain [gold]Innocent[/gold]. At the start of each player turn while [gold]Innocent[/gold], draw [blue]2[/blue] cards, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Energy[/gold], and gain [blue]8[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold]. When you take unblocked enemy [gold]Attack[/gold] damage, lose [gold]Innocent[/gold], lose [blue]8[/blue] HP immediately, and cannot regain [gold]Innocent[/gold] this combat.
A sealed token from before evidence is heard.
EZMICROBALANCE-LOTHA_PUBLIC_EVIDENCE_OPT: When you apply a non-damaging [gold]negative status[/gold] to an enemy, double its stacks and gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Enlightenment[/gold]. When an enemy applies a non-damaging [gold]negative status[/gold] to you, double its stacks and lose [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Enlightenment[/gold]. [gold]Poison[/gold], damage-over-time, and countdown damage do not count. At the start of your turn, consume up to [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Enlightenment[/gold]. For each, draw [blue]1[/blue] card and gain [blue]4[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
A sealed token laid where all can see it.
EZMICROBALANCE-LOTHA_SINGLE_SENTENCE_OPT: Each turn, your first [gold]Attack[/gold] or [gold]Skill[/gold] plays [blue]2[/blue] extra times. After that, you can play only [blue]4[/blue] more cards this turn. If your first card before the sentence is a [gold]Power[/gold], it costs [blue]0[/blue] and draws [blue]1[/blue] instead.
A sealed token written in one line.
Start a real fight with Vakuu. After your hand is drawn on turns [blue]1[/blue], [blue]3[/blue], [blue]5[/blue], and so on, Vakuu puts [gold]Temptation[/gold] on top of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold]. No normal combat rewards appear. Victory offers [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]3[/blue] non-Vakuu Act [blue]3[/blue] Ancient blessings if enough remain; otherwise no extra blessing. If you die, the run ends.
A warning and an invitation etched on the same blade.
EZMICROBALANCE-MORVI_FORBIDDEN_LOAN_OPTI: Choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]3[/blue] upgraded [gold]Ancient[/gold] cards. Playing the [gold]Borrowed[/gold] card costs [blue]1[/blue] HP for [gold]Attack[/gold] or [gold]Skill[/gold], or [blue]8[/blue] HP for [gold]Power[/gold]. After the Act [blue]2[/blue] boss, pay [blue]180[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold] to keep it if possible; otherwise Morvi removes it.
A sealed token signed in the margin.
EZMICROBALANCE-MORVI_MISPRINT_PRESS_OPTI: Each turn, the first player-played [gold]Attack[/gold] or [gold]Skill[/gold] plays [blue]1[/blue] additional time. Base-cost [blue]1[/blue]+ cards draw [blue]1[/blue]. [gold]Power[/gold], Status, Curse, autoplay, and generated cards do not trigger.
A sealed token stamped twice by mistake.
EZMICROBALANCE-MORVI_RED_INK_OVERDRAFT_O: Each turn, add a temporary [gold]Overdraft[/gold] card if hand space allows. Once per turn at [blue]0[/blue] [gold]Energy[/gold], play it to draw [blue]2[/blue], gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Energy[/gold], and add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]red-ink debt[/gold]. Each [gold]red-ink debt[/gold] costs [blue]12[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold] at combat end, or [blue]3[/blue] nonlethal HP if unpaid.
A sealed token whose ink refuses to dry.
EZMICROBALANCE-MORVI_OVERDUE_LIBRARY_OPT: At combat start, add [blue]3[/blue] random temporary [gold]Archive Pages[/gold] to hand. Pages cost [blue]0[/blue], are [gold]Ethereal[/gold] and [gold]Exhaust[/gold], and are removed after combat.
A sealed token tucked behind the last shelf.
EZMICROBALANCE-MORVI_OPEN_BOOK_EXAM_OPTI: On turn [blue]1[/blue], draw [blue]5[/blue] extra cards and gain [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Energy[/gold]. Extra-drawn cards left in hand at turn end are sealed in the [gold]Exhaust Pile[/gold], then return on turn [blue]3[/blue] as [blue]0[/blue]-cost cards if hand space allows.
A sealed token folded into a cheat sheet.
EZMICROBALANCE-MORVI_PAPERSTORM_OPTION_R: At combat start, shuffle [blue]4[/blue] [gold]Waste Paper[/gold] Status cards into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold]. Each turn, the first [blue]2[/blue] Status cards drawn from the [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] are consumed; each draws [blue]1[/blue] and grants [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Energy[/gold].
A sealed token caught in a rising stack of forms.
EZMICROBALANCE-MORVI_BLUEPRINT_PROOF_OPT: At combat start, gain [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Proofread[/gold]. Your first [blue]3[/blue] non-Status, non-Curse player-played deck cards get a one-play benefit: unupgraded cards temporarily upgrade and draw [blue]1[/blue]; upgraded cards cost [blue]1[/blue] less [gold]Energy[/gold] and gain [blue]4[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
A sealed token corrected in blue pencil.
EZMICROBALANCE-MORVI_DEBT_SETTLEMENT_OPT: Immediately gain [blue]220[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold], remove up to [blue]2[/blue] cards, and upgrade up to [blue]2[/blue] cards. Then set [gold]Debt[/gold] to [blue]320[/blue]. Each combat end, [blue]40[/blue] [gold]Debt[/gold] comes due; pay [gold]Gold[/gold] first, then lose [blue]3[/blue] nonlethal HP per [blue]10[/blue] short, rounded up. [gold]Debt[/gold] drops by the due amount either way.
A sealed token stamped PAID IN ADVANCE.
VELVET_CHOKER.description: Gain 1 Energy. Each turn, the 7th and later cards played from your hand cost 1 more.
WAR_HAMMER.description: On pickup, choose 2 cards to upgrade. Whenever you defeat an Elite, randomly upgrade 4 cards.
WHISPERING_EARRING.description: Gain 1 Energy. During the first 3 turns of each combat, after drawing, automatically play your highest-cost playable card.
